in_marathi.name: Banti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Pleasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Banti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Banti is the goddess of pleasure and sensuality. She is often depicted as a beautiful, voluptuous woman who grants desires related to pleasure and happiness. Banti is also known as Rati, the wife of the god of love, Kamadeva.
